transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... I just feel like the warm part of me kind of shut off. Like, I'll get off work and sit with my husband, or try to watch my shows, and... I know I should feel comfortable, or at least a little happy. But... I don't know. There's just nothing there.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I wouldn't say I feel depressed, exactly. It's not... sadness. I just feel kind of empty, I guess. Like I'm just going through the motions.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
Um... no, not really. I still do the things I usually do. I just... I don't know.
Can you think of something you used to enjoy, even a little, like a hobby or time with friends—do you still get any pleasure from it, or does it feel like it doesn't affect you anymore?
I mean... I guess I still try to do things. Like I said, I watch my shows. But... I don't really know if I get pleasure from it. It's just... something to do. I haven't really thought about it.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to focus or concentrate on tasks, like work or even simple daily activities?
I don't think so. Work is just... stocking shelves. You don't really need to think about it much. So, no... I haven't noticed anything different.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
Um... no. Not really. I eat about the same, I guess. I haven't really been paying attention to my weight or anything.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?
I haven't really noticed anything like that. I just... do what I need to do. I don't think I'm moving any slower, and I'm not really restless either. Just... normal, I guess.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty about things you've done, even if they don't seem like a big deal to others?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really done anything to feel guilty about. So, no.
Can you tell me if you’ve been feeling this way — like you’re just going through the motions — for most days over the past two weeks or longer?
I don't really know. I don't keep track of the days like that. I don't think it's been that long, though.
Can you tell me if you've been feeling this way — like you're just going through the motions — for most days over the past two weeks?
Um... I think you just asked me that. Like I said, I don't really keep track. It hasn't been two weeks, though. Just... recently, I guess.
Can you tell me if you've been feeling this way—like you're just going through the motions—on most days for at least two weeks in a row?
I... I mean, you keep asking me the same thing. I already told you, it hasn't been two weeks. I just... I don't know. No.
Can you tell me if you've felt this way — like you're just going through the motions — on most days for at least two weeks in a row, even if it was a shorter period recently?
I... look, I don't really understand why you keep asking me the exact same thing. I just told you no. It hasn't been two weeks.

Can you describe how you feel while doing your usual activities, like watching your shows or being with your husband? Do you feel anything at all, or does it feel like you're just going through the motions without any real sense of enjoyment or emotion?

I guess... that's kind of what made me come in. It just feels like the warm part of me shut off. Like, after work, I'll sit with my husband, or try to watch my shows, and... I know I should feel comfort, or at least a little happy. But... I don't know. There's just nothing there.
Can you tell me if you've had days where your mood has felt persistently low or empty, almost every day, for a period of at least two weeks?
I... I feel like you're asking me about the same timeframe again. The empty part, yes, I just said that. But... no. Not for two weeks. It just hasn't been that long.
Can you think of something you used to enjoy, even a little, like a hobby or time with friends—do you still get any pleasure from it, or does it feel like it doesn’t affect you anymore?
I don't really know. I... I just go to work and come home. Like I said about the TV shows... it just doesn't do anything for me right now. I don't really have anything else to add to that.
Can you tell me if you’ve noticed that activities which used to bring you even a little joy or interest no longer do, or if they feel like they don’t affect you the way they used to?
I... didn't you just ask me that? I really don't know what else to say. It's exactly like I just told you. I don't have anything else to add.
Can you tell me if there has been a time when activities or things you used to enjoy, even just a little, no longer felt rewarding or interesting to you, and if that lasted for two weeks or more?

I... I really feel like you're just asking me the exact same thing again. Like I said before... it hasn't been two weeks. None of this has been going on for that long. I just... I don't know what else you want me to say.

Can you think of any activity, even something small, that you used to get some enjoyment out of — and if you do it now, does it still feel rewarding or does it just not affect you the same way anymore?

Look... you keep asking me the exact same thing. I don't know how else to explain it to you. 

Honestly, it's... it's kind of what made me come in. I just feel like... I don't know, like the warm part of me shut off. I'll sit with my husband, or try to watch my shows after work, and... I know I should feel comfort, or even a little happy, but... there's just nothing there. I really don't know what else to tell you.
Can you think of any activity you used to enjoy, even just a little, where you now feel like you don’t get anything out of it anymore?
I... I really don't know why we're still talking about this. I've told you everything I can. There's nothing else to say.

Can you think of any activity, even something small, that you used to enjoy or get a little pleasure from — and if you do it now, does it still feel rewarding or does it just not affect you the same way anymore?
I... I really don't understand why you keep asking me this. I don't... I don't have anything else to add. I just want to move on.
